bugs.criterion: Dashboard never silently falls back to DEMO in LIVE mode
bugs.description: GET /api/market-data/dashboard?symbol=NIFTY correctly reports source=KOTAK_NEO, state=MARKET_CLOSED, spot.ltp=0 and an empty option_chain before any real tick -- but backend/routers/dashboard.py's waiting_live_snapshot() sets feed.last_tick = datetime.now(UTC) (line 24: `last_tick = status.last_tick or now`) whenever no real tick exists yet. This fabricates a tick timestamp: GET /api/market-data/feed-status correctly reports last_tick=null (no real tick), but the very same moment GET /api/market-data/dashboard?symbol=NIFTY reports feed.last_tick as a live-looking ISO timestamp equal to the request time. models/dashboard.py's FeedHealth.last_tick is a required (non-Optional) datetime, which forces this fabrication. This directly violates the 'no fake last_tick exists' / 'not simulated data or fake prices' contract even though the rest of the payload (source, state, spot, chain) is correct.
bugs.evidence: pytest tests/test_tscheck_dashboard_market_closed_truthful.py::test_dashboard_reports_kotak_neo_market_closed_with_empty_chain_before_ticks -> AssertionError: feed-status reports no real tick yet (last_tick=null), but the dashboard's feed.last_tick was '2026-09-24T01:09:30.436462Z'. Reproduced 3x across separate pytest runs (01:07:46, 01:07:?, 01:09:30 -- each within milliseconds of the request), confirming it is not flaky. Direct curl cross-check: `curl /api/market-data/feed-status` -> {"last_tick":null,...} vs `curl /api/market-data/dashboard?symbol=NIFTY` -> {"feed":{"last_tick":"<current server time>","source":"KOTAK_NEO","state":"MARKET_CLOSED"}}.

notes: Ran against localhost:8001 for backend pytest (16 tests across 4 new files + 2 pre-existing AI files) and against the public ingress https://kotak-neo-options.preview.emergentagent.com for all 3 browser checks (APP_URL from backend/.env). Exactly 8 acceptance criteria; each got a browser and/or backend artifact per the API-backed-UI-criterion rule (5 backend test files, 3 browser checks = 8 artifacts covering 8 criteria, with 1 criterion — dashboard-never-fake-DEMO — additionally covered implicitly by the after-hours-ui-truthful browser check since the UI reads the same buggy feed.last_tick field but tolerates it via the 'as of' timestamp path). The single failure (fabricated feed.last_tick in the dashboard endpoint's waiting_live_snapshot()) was reproduced 3x across independent pytest runs at different timestamps -- not flaky, real bug in backend/routers/dashboard.py + models/dashboard.py's non-optional FeedHealth.last_tick. All backend restarts during this iteration were caused by the dev server's own WatchFiles reload picking up newly-created test files (transient expiry=null observed once immediately after a reload, then confirmed passing on rerun -- correctly excluded from bug classification).
